description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_ContentSets, which manages content sets used within the HTMLPurifier library. It includes properties for storing content set info, lookups, keys, and values, as well as methods for constructing content sets from modules, generating child definitions and callbacks, getting child definitions based on content models, and converting strings to lookup arrays.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ContentSets
classes.description: A class for managing content sets, including merging sets from modules, expanding identifiers, and generating child element definitions based on content models.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs content sets from given modules, merging and expanding identifiers, and populating info, lookup, keys, and values.

methods.name: generateChildDef
methods.description: Generates a child definition for an element, expanding content models into appropriate ChildDef objects.

methods.name: generateChildDefCallback
methods.description: Callback used to replace content set identifiers in content models with their actual definitions.

methods.name: getChildDef
methods.description: Creates a ChildDef object based on the content_model and content_model_type of an element definition.

methods.name: convertToLookup
methods.description: Converts a pipe-separated string of element names into an associative array for lookup.
